action: package main import ( "fmt" "io" "net/http" "strings" ) func decideUnsubscribe(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { if r.Method != http.MethodPost { http.Error(w, "Method not allowed", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed) return } // Read the raw email from the request body emailContent, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body) if err != nil { http.Error(w, "Failed to read request body", http.StatusBadRequest) return } // Extract the "From" email address fromLinePrefix := "From:" fromLineStart := strings.Index(string(emailContent), fromLinePrefix) if fromLineStart == -1 { http.Error(w, "Invalid email format", http.StatusBadRequest) return } fromLineEnd := strings.Index(string(emailContent[fromLineStart:]), "\n") if fromLineEnd == -1 { http.Error(w, "Invalid email format", http.StatusBadRequest) return } fromLine := string(emailContent[fromLineStart : fromLineStart+fromLineEnd]) fromEmail := strings.TrimSpace(strings.Split(fromLine, ":")[1]) // Check for unsubscribe keywords unsubscribeKeywords := []string{"unsubscribe", "remove me", "deregister me", "stop sending me", "delete me"} unsubscribe := false for _, keyword := range unsubscribeKeywords { if strings.Contains(strings.ToLower(string(emailContent)), keyword) { unsubscribe = true break } } // Prepare the response response := fmt.Sprintf(`{"email": "%s", "unsubscribe": %t}`, fromEmail, unsubscribe) w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json") w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK) w.Write([]byte(response)) } func main() { http.HandleFunc("/decideUnsubscribe", decideUnsubscribe) http.ListenAndServe("0.0.0.0:5000", nil) }
